hints.title: Disjoint Trajectories
hints.text: Notice that Child 1 is strictly restricted to the main diagonal, while Child 2 and Child 3 stay strictly in the upper and lower triangles until meeting at the end.

hints.title: Independent Path Optimization
hints.text: Since paths only share the destination cell, you can solve for Child 2 and Child 3 independently using grid transitions.

hints.title: Boundary Clipping
hints.text: For Child 2 in row r, valid column c must satisfy c > r and c >= n - 1 - r so that destination (n-1, n-1) remains reachable.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Main diagonal path is fixed; upper and lower triangle paths are solved independently via DP transitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating 3^(n-1) paths for each child causes combinatorial explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) DP tables cache optimal paths in each triangle.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that the three paths are disjoint except at the destination cell.
